description: This file contains test functions for CSV file reading and writing utilities within the 'filesystem' package, using the 'testing' framework and 'testify/assert' for assertions.

methods.name: TestGenerateCSVLines
methods.description: Tests reading CSV lines from a file and verifies line count and column count

methods.name: TestNonExistentFile
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to read a nonexistent CSV file, expecting an error

methods.name: TestWriteCSVToFile
methods.description: Tests writing CSV data to a file and verifies correctness by reading it back
